messages:
Nina R (PM): Quick problem: timeline unchanged but infra quota cut. Need a concrete carve-out plan — what stays in MVP vs moves to v1? Demo in 10 days.

Calvin D (Eng): Short answer: keep routing, model pinning, telemetry. Cut global embeddings and quantized kernels to v1. Can we live with a smaller cache for pilots?

Asha M (Eng-ML): A compact pilot cache (per-tenant, prefix-only) seems fine. It stabilizes latency for demos without full rebuilds. Risk: slight output cache skew — we'll monitor.

Jon P (SRE): Ops note: if we do pilot caches we need tenant isolation and a throttle to avoid cascading load. I can add a token-bucket hook in the control plane. ~2d work.

Eli T (Sales): From customer side they want the demo to feel production. Pilot cache + "pilot" badge is acceptable if we call out limits. Important: per-tenant pinning MUST be visible in the console.

Nina R (PM): Proposal: MVP = routing + per-tenant pinning + pilot-scoped prefix cache + regression harness for pinned models + basic latency/error charts. v1 = global embeddings cache, quantization, optimized batching. Decision?

Calvin D (Eng): Agree. Implementation notes: prefix cache design: in-memory LRU, key = sha1(prefix), TTL = 90s, cap = 1500 entries. Expose a feature flag: feature.pilot_cache.<tenant_id>. I'll spike it tomorrow.

Asha M (Eng-ML): Regression harness: 40 prompt checks focused on customer-critical flows. We'll fingerprint outputs and fail if >5% token-level drift. I can deliver this in ~1.5d scoped to pinned models.

Jon P (SRE): Throttle plan: token-bucket per-tenant with burst=50 reqs, rate=10 reqs/s. Auto-disable pilot flag if 95th latency > 500ms for 3 consecutive windows. Will document rollback playbook.

Eli T (Sales): I'll prep customer messaging and a quick demo script that highlights "pilot" constraints. Need the console toggle callout to show in the demo.

Nina R (PM): Actions (short):
- Calvin: spike + PR for prefix cache + feature flag (2.5d)
- Asha: regression harness + gating rule (1.5d)
- Jon: throttle + runbook + auto-disable hook (2d)
- Eli: customer note + demo script (0.5d)
- Nina: file v1 backlog + update milestone doc (today)

release-bot: Reminder: branch freeze 2024-03-12T18:00 UTC.

Calvin D (Eng): I'll start the spike this afternoon and tag the demo branch. Ping me if anything blocks integration.

Asha M (Eng-ML): Tuning note: set fingerprint tolerance conservatively for the demo models. If we see false positives we can relax to token-level edit distance < 4%.

Jon P (SRE): Will add alerting to the canary dashboard and pre-populate thresholds.

Nina R (PM): OK decision locked. We'll surface the pilot caveats explicitly in the exec one-pager. Reconvene EOD Friday for a brief status check. :thumbsup:
